usage: 越南 is used as a proper noun referring to the country Vietnam.
It can be the subject or object in a sentence when talking about Vietnamese people, food, or culture.
越南 is often paired with verbs like 去 (to go) or 來 (to come) when discussing travel.
When combined with 話 (language), 越南話 means the Vietnamese language.
越南 can be used with terms like 飲食 (food) or 文化 (culture) to specify Vietnamese cuisine or culture.
